title: DJ TURN ME UP
lines: Dj turn me up is a data center on the moon.
It keeps 950 shots from 126 films. Every film is a tower, every shot a floor, every frame a window.
Its 3 streets are the scenes of the poem, in order: the first is “DJ appears, spins and scratches”.
The tallest tower is Master Hands: 36 floors.
Nothing in it is older than 1897 or newer than 2018.
The sign most often read here is restrained dream.
